sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: UK studio Hudson Architects has converted a disused commercial building in Norfolk into a public library, wrapping its existing concrete structure in a skin of cement shingles. Named King's Lynn Library, the project adapted the neglected structure of a former nightclub, car park and retail store into a more central home for the local library, The post Hudson Architects transforms neglected nightclub into King's Lynn Library appeared first on Dezeen .
